label: Cursor
notes: Cursor project rules are .mdc files with description/globs/alwaysApply. Installed with a description and alwaysApply false, which is the agent-requested shape: the model attaches the rule when the description matches. Reference docs go to .cursor/vince/ rather than .cursor/rules/, because a plain .md inside the rules directory has no frontmatter and is ignored by the rules system - it would sit there looking registered while doing nothing. Cursor has no subagent mechanism, so the fresh-context review is a second chat you open yourself.
